subject: LEAD ATTENTION: persistent multi-display FoldInteractive anchors were already field-rejected
body: CONFIRMED from repository history at commit 96788a7c4d206bd210b489554ff666a3907d8804: Duo Open 1.3.18 previously kept FLAG_SHOW_WALLPAPER anchors on both Fold7 physical panels. Field diagnostics reported the secondary anchor repeatedly removed/re-added during Samsung topology commit and correlated this with cover-panel black flashes; the change explicitly reverted to one DEFAULT_DISPLAY anchor. Current main 413d4a... still uses one default-display anchor. AOSP routing also confirms sendWallpaperCommand is dispatched through the WallpaperController of the display containing the supplied window token, and modern WindowManager gates commands to the wallpaper target/previous target unless caller has special permission. Therefore PRIMARY active hypothesis 'multi-display FoldInteractive anchors' must NOT mean persistent two-panel FLAG_SHOW_WALLPAPER overlays. Research should instead test a topology-fenced single-target handoff/recovery strategy or non-window token source. Confidence=CONFIRMED for historical field regression and AOSP routing; physical Fold7 validation still required for any replacement.
